$comment: Single source of truth for cross-language physics constants. Regenerate: npm run codegen:constants

vdg.comment: Classroom Van de Graaff lumped ODE — not an HV engineering design. C = 4πε₀r; V_break = kelvin.eBreakdownVm × gapM.

hall.comment: Classroom Hall bench: V_H = I·B/(n·e·t). Carrier profiles toggle semiconductor vs metal.

transformer.comment: Classroom coupled-inductor L-M RK4 ODE, shared by the C++ plant and the TS fallback (which is a term-for-term port of it, not a phasor approximation). Not FEM.

peltier.comment: Classroom two-node thermoelectric stack (Bi2Te3 couple, Seebeck + Peltier + Joule; Thomson neglected). Converged set: the C++ plant numbers, which already matched scientific-data.ts PELTIER_DATA. The pre-codegen JS fallback ran a different set (seebeck 2.0e-4, rInternal 2.2, rLoad 4.0, heaterMax 45 W, ambient 298 K) - retired.

mhd.comment: Hartmann-style MHD channel: pressure-driven liquid-metal flow braked by Lorentz drag, V = B*u*w through a resistive divider. Converged set: the C++ plant numbers (NaK-like working fluid). The pre-codegen JS fallback ran a different set (pumpAccel 4.5, lorentzK 0.85, sigma 7.1e5, rho 6400, w 0.12, halfGap 0.04, nu 1.2e-6, rInternal 0.08, rLoad 0.25) - retired.

maglev.comment: Maglev gap spring-damper. JS and C++ already agreed on k/c/m; the only divergence was gravity (JS literal 9.81 vs physical.G) - both now use physical.G.

homopolar.comment: Faraday-disc homopolar generator, L-R loop with back-EMF e = 0.5*B*omega*r^2. Converged set: the C++ plant numbers. The JS fallback derived B as min(0.55, segMagnet.Br*0.28) = 0.414 T; the classroom value is now the 0.55 T the C++ plant has always used.

lorentzSled.comment: Classroom rail-motor sled (educational Lorentz-force model, not a railgun design tool). JS LORENTZ and the C++ LorentzState already agreed term for term; codegen now keeps them that way.

pulseCoil.comment: JS-only by design (ADR-0002: no wasmMode) - TS codegen only, no C++ plant. Series R-L coil with a low-voltage capacitor-bank discharge metaphor; the armature travel is an attraction proxy, not a projectile model.

halbachViz.comment: JS-only by design (ADR-0002: no wasmMode) - TS codegen only. Ring geometry + the segment-count / magnetisation-angle sweep the drive slider walks through. SCENE_SCALE stays in halbach-viz.ts: it is a render scale, not a physical constant.

sceneScaling.notes: Visualization layouts in src/seg-layout.js map real metres to scene units via per-preset worldScale. Plant integrators may apply additional scene gravity scaling in WASM (see sim_core.cpp).

wasmSegDefaults.comment: Default ring topology for WASM SEGSimulator only — not the visual layout presets.

energyNetwork.comment: Lab bus nameplate watts for EnergyNetwork / sim_core bus — simulated order-of-magnitude only, not metrology.
